accounts_owner_scope_ck.name: accounts_owner_scope_ck
accounts_owner_scope_ck.value:
("accounts"."base_id" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."owner_wallet" IS NULL AND "accounts"."kind" IN ('base_shards', 'base_forge_escrow'))
    OR
    ("accounts"."base_id" IS NULL AND "accounts"."owner_wallet" IS NOT NULL AND "accounts"."kind" IN ('player_keep', 'player_sol_credit', 'player_shards'))
    OR
    ("accounts"."base_id" IS NULL AND "accounts"."owner_wallet" IS NULL AND "accounts"."kind" NOT IN ('player_keep', 'player_sol_credit', 'player_shards', 'base_shards', 'base_forge_escrow'))

base_economy_backfills_completion_ck.name: base_economy_backfills_completion_ck
base_economy_backfills_completion_ck.value:
("base_economy_backfills"."ledger_status" = 'complete' AND "base_economy_backfills"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND (("base_economy_backfills"."legacy_shard_balance" = 0 AND "base_economy_backfills"."ledger_transfer_txn_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("base_economy_backfills"."legacy_shard_balance" > 0 AND "base_economy_backfills"."ledger_transfer_txn_id" IS NOT NULL))
      AND (("base_economy_backfills"."legacy_forge_escrow_shards" = 0 AND "base_economy_backfills"."forge_ledger_transfer_txn_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("base_economy_backfills"."legacy_forge_escrow_shards" > 0 AND "base_economy_backfills"."forge_ledger_transfer_txn_id" IS NOT NULL)))
    OR ("base_economy_backfills"."ledger_status" <> 'complete' AND "base_economy_backfills"."completed_at" IS NULL)

base_forge_positions_amounts_ck.name: base_forge_positions_amounts_ck
base_forge_positions_amounts_ck.value:
"base_forge_positions"."contributed_shards" >= 0
    AND "base_forge_positions"."raid_debited_shards" >= 0
    AND "base_forge_positions"."raid_debited_shards" <= "base_forge_positions"."contributed_shards"
    AND ("base_forge_positions"."counted_shards" IS NULL OR "base_forge_positions"."counted_shards" >= 0)
    AND ("base_forge_positions"."shards_refunded" IS NULL OR "base_forge_positions"."shards_refunded" >= 0)
    AND ("base_forge_positions"."keep_paid" IS NULL OR "base_forge_positions"."keep_paid" >= 0)
    AND ("base_forge_positions"."counted_shards" IS NULL OR "base_forge_positions"."counted_shards" <= "base_forge_positions"."contributed_shards" - "base_forge_positions"."raid_debited_shards")

base_forge_positions_custody_ck.name: base_forge_positions_custody_ck
base_forge_positions_custody_ck.value:
("base_forge_positions"."settled_at" IS NULL
      AND "base_forge_positions"."counted_shards" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."shards_refunded" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."keep_paid" IS NULL
      AND "base_forge_positions"."settlement_owner_wallet" IS NULL
      AND "base_forge_positions"."shard_settlement_txn_id" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."keep_escrow_txn_id" IS NULL
      AND "base_forge_positions"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."claim_txn_id" IS NULL
      AND "base_forge_positions"."expired_at" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."expire_txn_id" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("base_forge_positions"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "base_forge_positions"."counted_shards" IS NOT NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."shards_refunded" IS NOT NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."keep_paid" IS NOT NULL
      AND "base_forge_positions"."settlement_owner_wallet" IS NOT NULL
      AND (("base_forge_positions"."counted_shards" = 0 AND "base_forge_positions"."shard_settlement_txn_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("base_forge_positions"."counted_shards" > 0 AND "base_forge_positions"."shard_settlement_txn_id" IS NOT NULL))
      AND (("base_forge_positions"."keep_paid" = 0 AND "base_forge_positions"."keep_escrow_txn_id" IS NULL
          AND "base_forge_positions"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."claim_txn_id" IS NULL
          AND "base_forge_positions"."expired_at" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."expire_txn_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("base_forge_positions"."keep_paid" > 0 AND "base_forge_positions"."keep_escrow_txn_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND (("base_forge_positions"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."claim_txn_id" IS NULL
              AND "base_forge_positions"."expired_at" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."expire_txn_id" IS NULL)
            OR ("base_forge_positions"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."claim_txn_id" IS NOT NULL
              AND "base_forge_positions"."expired_at" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."expire_txn_id" IS NULL)
            OR ("base_forge_positions"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."claim_txn_id" IS NULL
              AND "base_forge_positions"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL AND "base_forge_positions"."expire_txn_id" IS NOT NULL)))))

base_training_queue_state_ck.name: base_training_queue_state_ck
base_training_queue_state_ck.value:
("base_training_queue"."economy_version" = 1 AND "base_training_queue"."paid_shard_cost" IS NULL AND "base_training_queue"."debit_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
      AND "base_training_queue"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "base_training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
      AND "base_training_queue"."cancel_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "base_training_queue"."quest_credited_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("base_training_queue"."economy_version" = 2 AND "base_training_queue"."paid_shard_cost" > 0 AND "base_training_queue"."debit_ledger_txn_id" IS NOT NULL AND (
      ("base_training_queue"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "base_training_queue"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "base_training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
        AND "base_training_queue"."cancel_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "base_training_queue"."quest_credited_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("base_training_queue"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "base_training_queue"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "base_training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
        AND "base_training_queue"."cancel_idempotency_key" IS NULL)
      OR ("base_training_queue"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "base_training_queue"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "base_training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "base_training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" <> "base_training_queue"."debit_ledger_txn_id"
        AND "base_training_queue"."cancel_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "base_training_queue"."quest_credited_at" IS NULL)
    ))

deed_economy_cutover_state_ready_ck.name: deed_economy_cutover_state_ready_ck
deed_economy_cutover_state_ready_ck.value:
("deed_economy_cutover_state"."phase" = 'fenced' AND "deed_economy_cutover_state"."ready_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("deed_economy_cutover_state"."phase" = 'ready' AND "deed_economy_cutover_state"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL)

forge_unclaimed_idx.name: forge_unclaimed_idx
forge_unclaimed_idx.where: claimed_at is null and expired_at is null and keep_escrow_txn_id is not null

global_chat_reports_resolution_ck.name: global_chat_reports_resolution_ck
global_chat_reports_resolution_ck.value:
("global_chat_reports"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "global_chat_reports"."resolved_by" IS NULL AND "global_chat_reports"."resolution" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("global_chat_reports"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "global_chat_reports"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL
      AND "global_chat_reports"."resolution" IN ('dismissed', 'redacted'))

item_listings_base_custody_ck.name: item_listings_base_custody_ck
item_listings_base_custody_ck.value:
("item_listings"."base_id" IS NULL AND "item_listings"."buyer_base_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("item_listings"."base_id" IS NOT NULL AND (
      ("item_listings"."status" IN ('active', 'cancelled') AND "item_listings"."buyer_base_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("item_listings"."status" IN ('reserved', 'sold') AND "item_listings"."buyer_base_id" IS NOT NULL)
    ))

mail_attachments_payload_ck.name: mail_attachments_payload_ck
mail_attachments_payload_ck.value:
("mail_attachments"."kind" IN ('KEEP', 'SHARDS') AND "mail_attachments"."amount" > 0
      AND "mail_attachments"."item_id" IS NULL AND "mail_attachments"."qty" IS NULL)
    OR ("mail_attachments"."kind" = 'ITEM' AND "mail_attachments"."amount" IS NULL
      AND "mail_attachments"."item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "mail_attachments"."qty" > 0)

mail_messages_sender_ck.name: mail_messages_sender_ck
mail_messages_sender_ck.value:
("mail_messages"."sender_kind" = 'system' AND "mail_messages"."sender_wallet" IS NULL)
    OR ("mail_messages"."sender_kind" = 'admin' AND "mail_messages"."sender_wallet" IS NOT NULL)

mail_messages_lifecycle_ck.name: mail_messages_lifecycle_ck
mail_messages_lifecycle_ck.value:
("mail_messages"."kind" = 'info' AND "mail_messages"."reward_state" IS NULL AND "mail_messages"."expires_at" IS NULL
      AND "mail_messages"."reserve_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL AND "mail_messages"."claim_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
      AND "mail_messages"."unwind_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL AND "mail_messages"."claim_base_id" IS NULL
      AND "mail_messages"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "mail_messages"."expired_at" IS NULL)
    OR
    ("mail_messages"."kind" = 'reward' AND "mail_messages"."reward_state" IN ('pending', 'claimed', 'expired')
      AND "mail_messages"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        ("mail_messages"."reward_state" = 'pending' AND "mail_messages"."claim_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
          AND "mail_messages"."unwind_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL AND "mail_messages"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "mail_messages"."expired_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("mail_messages"."reward_state" = 'claimed' AND "mail_messages"."unwind_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
          AND "mail_messages"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "mail_messages"."expired_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("mail_messages"."reward_state" = 'expired' AND "mail_messages"."claim_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
          AND "mail_messages"."claim_base_id" IS NULL AND "mail_messages"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "mail_messages"."expired_at" IS NOT NULL)
      ))

players_totp_enabled_at_ck.name: players_totp_enabled_at_ck
players_totp_enabled_at_ck.value: (totp_enabled AND totp_enabled_at IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT totp_enabled AND totp_enabled_at IS NULL)

push_events_outcome_ck.name: push_events_outcome_ck
push_events_outcome_ck.value:
("push_events"."outcome" IS NULL AND "push_events"."sent_at" IS NULL AND "push_events"."delivery_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("push_events"."outcome" = 'sent' AND "push_events"."sent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "push_events"."delivery_id" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("push_events"."outcome" IN ('failed', 'capped', 'suppressed') AND "push_events"."sent_at" IS NULL AND "push_events"."delivery_id" IS NULL)

quest_bucket_retirement_state_ready_ck.name: quest_bucket_retirement_state_ready_ck
quest_bucket_retirement_state_ready_ck.value:
("quest_bucket_retirement_state"."phase" = 'fenced' AND "quest_bucket_retirement_state"."ready_at" IS NULL AND "quest_bucket_retirement_state"."reconciliation_txn_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("quest_bucket_retirement_state"."phase" = 'ready' AND "quest_bucket_retirement_state"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL)

raid_live_states_clock_v2_range_ck.name: raid_live_states_clock_v2_range_ck
raid_live_states_clock_v2_range_ck.value:
"raid_live_states"."clock_revision" >= 0
    AND "raid_live_states"."clock_rate" IN (1, 2)
    AND ("raid_live_states"."clock_anchor_sim_ms" IS NULL OR "raid_live_states"."clock_anchor_sim_ms" BETWEEN 0 AND 90000)

raid_live_states_clock_v2_state_ck.name: raid_live_states_clock_v2_state_ck
raid_live_states_clock_v2_state_ck.value:
"raid_live_states"."command_protocol_version" != 2
    OR (
      ("raid_live_states"."started_at" IS NULL AND "raid_live_states"."battle_ends_at" IS NULL
        AND "raid_live_states"."clock_anchor_wall_at" IS NULL AND "raid_live_states"."clock_anchor_sim_ms" IS NULL)
      OR ("raid_live_states"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "raid_live_states"."battle_ends_at" IS NOT NULL AND "raid_live_states"."battle_ends_at" > "raid_live_states"."started_at"
        AND "raid_live_states"."clock_anchor_wall_at" IS NOT NULL AND "raid_live_states"."clock_anchor_sim_ms" IS NOT NULL)
    )

raid_live_states_clock_ck.name: raid_live_states_clock_ck
raid_live_states_clock_ck.value:
("raid_live_states"."started_at" IS NULL AND "raid_live_states"."battle_ends_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("raid_live_states"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "raid_live_states"."battle_ends_at" > "raid_live_states"."started_at")

raid_loot_reservations_terminal_ck.name: raid_loot_reservations_terminal_ck
raid_loot_reservations_terminal_ck.value:
("raid_loot_reservations"."state" = 'reserved' AND "raid_loot_reservations"."settled_at" IS NULL AND "raid_loot_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("raid_loot_reservations"."state" = 'settled' AND "raid_loot_reservations"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "raid_loot_reservations"."released_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("raid_loot_reservations"."state" = 'released' AND "raid_loot_reservations"."released_at" IS NOT NULL AND "raid_loot_reservations"."settled_at" IS NULL)

totp_recoveries_timeline_ck.name: totp_recoveries_timeline_ck
totp_recoveries_timeline_ck.value:
("totp_recoveries"."status" = 'email_pending'
      AND "totp_recoveries"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "totp_recoveries"."ready_at" IS NULL
      AND "totp_recoveries"."expires_at" > "totp_recoveries"."requested_at"
      AND "totp_recoveries"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_at" IS NULL
      AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_session_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("totp_recoveries"."status" = 'holding'
      AND "totp_recoveries"."confirmed_at" >= "totp_recoveries"."requested_at" AND "totp_recoveries"."ready_at" > "totp_recoveries"."confirmed_at"
      AND "totp_recoveries"."expires_at" > "totp_recoveries"."ready_at"
      AND "totp_recoveries"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_at" IS NULL
      AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_session_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("totp_recoveries"."status" = 'cancelled'
      AND "totp_recoveries"."cancelled_at" >= "totp_recoveries"."requested_at" AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_at" IS NULL
      AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_session_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("totp_recoveries"."status" = 'completed'
      AND "totp_recoveries"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "totp_recoveries"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL
      AND "totp_recoveries"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_at" >= "totp_recoveries"."ready_at"
      AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_at" < "totp_recoveries"."expires_at" AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_session_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "totp_recoveries"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("totp_recoveries"."status" = 'expired'
      AND "totp_recoveries"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_at" IS NULL
      AND (("totp_recoveries"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "totp_recoveries"."ready_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("totp_recoveries"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "totp_recoveries"."ready_at" IS NOT NULL))
      AND "totp_recoveries"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "totp_recoveries"."completed_session_id" IS NULL)

training_queue_state_ck.name: training_queue_state_ck
training_queue_state_ck.value:
("training_queue"."economy_version" = 1 AND "training_queue"."paid_shard_cost" IS NULL AND "training_queue"."debit_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
      AND "training_queue"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
      AND "training_queue"."cancel_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "training_queue"."quest_credited_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("training_queue"."economy_version" = 2 AND "training_queue"."paid_shard_cost" > 0 AND "training_queue"."debit_ledger_txn_id" IS NOT NULL AND (
      ("training_queue"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "training_queue"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
        AND "training_queue"."cancel_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "training_queue"."quest_credited_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("training_queue"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "training_queue"."cancelled_at" IS NULL AND "training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" IS NULL
        AND "training_queue"."cancel_idempotency_key" IS NULL)
      OR ("training_queue"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "training_queue"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" IS NOT NULL
        AND "training_queue"."refund_ledger_txn_id" <> "training_queue"."debit_ledger_txn_id"
        AND "training_queue"."cancel_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "training_queue"."quest_credited_at" IS NULL)
    ))

withdrawal_attempts_terminal_finalized_a.name: withdrawal_attempts_terminal_finalized_at
withdrawal_attempts_terminal_finalized_a.value:
"withdrawal_attempts"."status" NOT IN ('finalized_success', 'finalized_error')
    OR "withdrawal_attempts"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL

withdrawal_authorizations_validation_pai.name: withdrawal_authorizations_validation_pair_ck
withdrawal_authorizations_validation_pai.value:
("withdrawal_authorizations"."validated_digest" IS NULL AND "withdrawal_authorizations"."validated_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("withdrawal_authorizations"."validated_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "withdrawal_authorizations"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL)
